# `try_mod`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
try_mod(dividend, divisor)
```

Returns the remainder after `expr1`/`expr2`. `dividend` must be a numeric. `divisor` must be a numeric.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.0 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- try_mod, example 1
> SELECT try_mod(3, 2);
1
```

```sql
-- try_mod, example 2
> SELECT try_mod(2L, 2L);
0
```

```sql
-- try_mod, example 3
> SELECT try_mod(3.0, 2.0);
1.0
```

```sql
-- try_mod, example 4
> SELECT try_mod(1, 0);
NULL
```
